# gitmoap_access_permissions (Data Source)

Every permission a role can hold, and the five built-in roles made of them. The same for every caller, and readable without signing in.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `roles` (Attributes List) The five built-in roles, lowest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `applies_at` (String) Where a grant carrying a permission has any effect.
- `key` (String) The permission's key, `{area}.{verb}` — for example `code.push`.
- `lowest_builtin_role` (String)
- `public_readable` (Boolean) Whether a Public or Internal group or repository lets people read this without being
given access.
- `requires` (List of String) The permissions this one is meaningless without. A role that holds it holds these too.
- `tier` (String) How dangerous granting a permission is, which decides whether a custom role may carry it.


<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The role's display name, such as `Developer`.
- `permissions` (List of String) Every permission the role holds, by key.
- `role` (String)
